verdict.rationale: Webhook-style event subscriptions are a conceivable capability for an authentication product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documented, registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The only notifications mentioned are push approvals to the user's phone and mirroring to wearables, which are not webhooks, and probes found no API surface (OpenAPI 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
